newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ROKISHKIS CHEESE MOST ACTIVE STOCK LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: ROKISHKIS CHEESE MOST ACTIVE STOCK LAST WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that Rokishkis Cheese was the most active stock on the central market last week in trade of 825,827 litas.
The bourse also said in a statement that Lithuanian Gas was the second most active central market share in trade of with 552,384 litas.
The third most active stock on the central market was the Lithuanian Sea Shipping company, which recorded a turnover of 347,248 litas.
Ukio bank was the most active stock in bloc trading in trade of 2.75 million litas litas week, the bourse said.
The Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company was also active in bloc trades with turnover worth 266,605 litas.
